contracts.name: Agent Skills specification
assumptions: A skill is a directory containing SKILL.md.
The portable frontmatter contract includes name and description.

contracts.name: Codex skill discovery
assumptions: Codex supports repository and user skill discovery.
Portable skills do not require model-provider API calls.

contracts.name: Omarchy Quattro shell contract
assumptions: Quattro plugins use a root manifest.json and hosted QML entry points.
Third-party plugin code executes inside the long-running shell process.
Reviewed 2026-09-29: third-party entry points receive capability-scoped facades and detached configuration snapshots, not trusted host objects; these are not same-process QML sandboxes.
Service-backed third-party widgets retain full own-service integration under the trusted built-in bar; replacement bars provide service-less entry facades.
keepLoaded services survive plugin hot-reload and require a shell restart for code changes.
Reviewed 2026-10-17 against current Quattro; installed host support remains authoritative.

contracts.name: Omarchy Plugin Workbench project definition
assumptions: Generated root plugins declare pluginPath as '.'.
Project commands are exact argument vectors and remain untrusted until the owner approves them.
Workflow capabilities require separate local approval and do not name an agent host.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace submission form
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-10-03: content is unchanged from the 24 September pin; implementation-level intake, migration and refresh changes are recorded separately.
Tags use form display labels; preserve exact headings and five acknowledgments.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace security review semantics
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-10-03: content is unchanged from the 24 September pin; implementation-level intake, migration and refresh changes are recorded separately.
New listing/update selective disposition may accept exact non-blocking findings; existing-snapshot maintainer-verified remains capability-only.
The portable advisory does not reproduce the authoritative baseline or prove runtime safety.

contracts.name: Omarchy Quattro multiselect settings example
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-09-22: Quattro uses multiselect in barWidget.schema.
Multiselect options may be objects with value, label and description; an options array is required by this portable checker.
Reviewed 2026-10-17 against current Quattro; installed host support remains authoritative.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace verification form

The standard-installation acknowledgment applies only to removal of a manual override.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace verification workflow
assumptions: Reviewed 2026-10-03: content is unchanged from the 24 September pin; implementation-level intake, migration and refresh changes are recorded separately.
Publication, verified snapshot and mutable current-upstream installation are separate states.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace CLI intake
assumptions: Malformed [Plugin]: requests are labeled for form-error reporting; this does not establish validation or approval.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace canonical verification subject
assumptions: A recorded former repository resolves only for its own existing listing; later scans and approval use the canonical repository.

contracts.name: Omarchy Agents panel plugin starter
assumptions: Plugin starter launches the default agent through omarchy-agent-prompt and requests the built-in plugin guide; it does not load this bundle.

contracts.name: Omarchy installed plugin guide
assumptions: Personal customization clones built-ins; user plugin code reloads on save.
Plugin-owned Commons.Translations catalogs support live switching, pluralization and RTL.
Layout includes centerBegin, centerEnd and tray; center placement must preserve clock geometry.

contracts.name: Omarchy bar placement contract
assumptions: defaultSection accepts all Util.barSections; automatic center placement maps to centerEnd.

assumptions: Qt 6.12 Color shadows unqualified palette references; use Commons.Color with an aliased import.
